contract: Revisioned subject-scoped organizations and fact holdings in the existing secret privacy.sqlite3. Declaring a current encrypted-fact revision change atomically propagates eligible holdings to update_pending. Derived per-change totals and revisioned user-reported updated/removed dispositions retain evidence and full organization, holding and target histories. HTTP/UI operate on masked fact metadata; native tools are read-only metadata and never accept values, passphrases, reveal, attestations, drafts or sends.
remaining_limits: No external sends or automatic organization contact

Optional update draft remains pending because this revision has no generic communications draft service; a future adapter must use an existing communications draft queue, explicit scoped consent and a transient authenticated passphrase, and must never send
Organization names, contact, source and disposition evidence are owner-visible metadata inside the secret local database
No private database export, replication or plaintext projection; central secret inventory classification remains root-owned
Disposition evidence is explicitly user-reported and is not independent verification
acceptance_coverage: revisioned organization create/update/archive and optimistic conflict handling
same-subject masked fact holdings with revision/status/history and invalid cross-subject refusal
atomic changed-fact propagation to every eligible active organization holding
derived pending/updated/removed/total progress after durable reopen
user-attested updated and removed dispositions with evidence and immutable target/holding history
metadata-only native reads with no plaintext, passphrase, mutation, attestation, draft or send operation
real isolated HTTP owner workflow with no-store and home isolation
real HTTP React organization, holding, change, progress, evidence, history and reload workflow
SQLite byte checks prove private values and transient passphrase remain absent from plaintext storage
